generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an evergreen shrub 1 to 3 m tall of many slender, upright grey stems from the base, open below, with small, resinous, dark olive leaflets in pairs at the twig tips and small yellow flowers after rain. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 1.3 m at 10 years and 2 m at 40. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: dark olive-green leaves, grey stems, yellow flowers. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth grey stems; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.
